lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning, I am head constable Suresh from Jubilee Hills police station.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am calling regarding your passport application for police verification.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will visit your house tomorrow between 11 and 1. Please keep your Aadhaar, address proof and two neighbours available as witnesses.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If tomorrow is not convenient you can also come to the station with the originals.
